output.reason: The cited line [ev-810697118f35] is just the metric name, but it is one of the items listed under the section intro [ev-1f419676f177]. That intro says these `cortex_`-prefixed metrics will change to start with `loki_` in this release. So the subject is the metric `cortex_prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total`, and the change is a rename to `loki_prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total`.
